parsed.name: GNSS基准站接收机
parsed.description: GNSS基准站接收机用于接收卫星导航信号，提供位置估计、可见卫星、接收机状态和时间同步信息，并可记录原始观测数据。它常用于定位实验、基站配置管理、天线安装验证和授时测试。
parsed.description_en: A GNSS base station receiver acquires satellite navigation signals and provides position estimates, visible-satellite data, receiver status, and time-synchronization information. It is commonly used for positioning experiments, base-station configuration, antenna setup validation, and timing tests.
